note: Migration rules (T-14, UC-07): human-confirmed recipes keyed to measured item deltas. Rules are data — versioned, reviewable, disableable; suggested (unconfirmed) rules are never applied by the engine. Every rule's transition provenance is checked against the dataset on load (gocar-gpui tests). Seed rule: the unofficial 1.17.2 profiler rewrite that removed the record_frame_* fns. Keys are v2 item-model identities (T-26): qualified under the pub `profiler` module (`fn:profiler::…`), and the successor's measured cfg gate is provenance-recorded — a default-feature 1.17.2+ build ships none of the FrameEvent machinery, which is exactly why the engine refuses to auto-apply this rename at those targets (see migrate's cfg-vouching, T-26).

rules.note: 1.17.2 removed record_frame_timing and added record_frame_event in the same profiler rewrite (FrameEvent machinery). Confirmed 2026-09-06 by the gocar maintainers as the mechanical successor for the T-14 v1 demo — the call shape is the same record-a-sample call. T-26 (2026-09-07): the keys are re-based onto the v2 qualified identity (`fn:profiler::…`); the measured successor is cfg-gated (`cfg(feature = "profiler")`) at 1.17.2+, so the migration engine refuses this rename at those targets unless the target build enables the feature — re-verify payload semantics (the payload is now FrameEvent::Draw(FrameTiming)) and the feature before relying on this rule.
